title: The Quantified Body: Identity, Empowerment, and Control in Smart Wearables
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a theoretical analysis of smart wearables and does not measure or benchmark any aspect of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion or faith; therefore, there are no findings on this topic.
